title: Marketplace renewal: acceptance path, escrow and capacity uplift for ArcLight Health
text:
Marketplace renewal: acceptance path, escrow and capacity uplift for ArcLight Health

["From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Voss <elena@arclight.health>, procurement@arclight.health
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Marketplace renewal: acceptance path, escrow and capacity uplift for ArcLight Health

Elena / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. Attached is the AWS Private Offer we discussed for the 12‑month renewal + 30% committed capacity uplift. High level next steps I propose:

- ArcLight to confirm acceptance (PO + sign) so marketplace transfer and billing can be aligned. We need PO on file by 2026-12-05 to avoid a mid‑term billing gap.
- Legal to review Exhibit A (SLA) and advise if a short-term exception for the dedicated pool is required while we queue capacity.
- We'll provide a DocuSign path for signatures and a bundled evidence packet for your procurement/audit team.

A couple of clarifications up front: quarterly invoicing is supported via marketplace billing (we'll show line items for committed units), and we can temporarily extend the current latency SLA by up to 90 days during capacity ramp — subject to legal review.

Attached: AWS_Private_Offer_ArcLight.pdf

If that timeline looks acceptable I can loop in our finance/legal for final redlines and share a DocuSign link. Would you be available for a 20‑minute call early next week if procurement needs runbook detail?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0123

----
Attachment: AWS_Private_Offer_ArcLight.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)
", "From: Elena Voss <elena@arclight.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@arclight.health
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: acceptance path, escrow and capacity uplift for ArcLight Health

Jordan —

Thanks for the offer. A few quick questions from procurement/legal:

1) Can you confirm the exact SLA language in Exhibit A we need to sign? Our legal wants explicit wording about incident severity and MTTR commitments.
2) Is the 90‑day SLA exception documented somewhere or is that an internal practice? We need a recorded, signed exception if we're relying on it during the ramp.
3) Can DocuSign support our procurement PO number field and a separate billing contact?

Also, due to data residency requirements for a subset of our workloads, our security team asked whether evidence for SOC2 and encryption-at-rest KMS info can be packaged with the offer. If you can attach the attestation and the DocuSign link, procurement will start routing.

Best,
Elena Voss
Head of Procurement, ArcLight Health
elena@arclight.health
procurement@arclight.health

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 3:12 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original message attached)
", "From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Voss <elena@arclight.health>, procurement@arclight.health
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: acceptance path, escrow and capacity uplift for ArcLight Health

Elena — great questions, thanks. Quick answers below and attaching the attestation and the DocuSign path:

1) SLA / Exhibit A: attached SLA_Attestation_ArcLight.docx contains the explicit severity definitions and MTTR targets we referenced. The core commitments are identical to the public Exhibit A; the attestation adds the temporary 90‑day ramp window language.
2) 90‑day exception: we will include a signed addendum that documents the temporary SLA variation — we can attach to the DocuSign envelope so it's recorded.
3) DocuSign: yes — the envelope supports custom fields (PO number, billing contact, and a separate signature block for your procurement). Link below.

I've included the DocuSign URL and attached the attestation. If legal wants to redline Exhibit A directly, please send their markups and we'll consolidate with our legal counsel.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-arc-light

Attachments: SLA_Attestation_ArcLight.docx (DOCX, 4 pages)

Happy to jump on a short call Wed/Thu to walk procurement through the line items if helpful.

Regards,
Jordan

> On Sat, Nov 21, 2026 at 09:04 AM Elena Voss <elena@arclight.health> wrote:
> > (previous message)
", "From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Voss <elena@arclight.health>, procurement@arclight.health
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: acceptance path, escrow and capacity uplift for ArcLight Health

Elena, Jordan —

I reviewed Legal's and Product's comments on Exhibit A and put together a short redline summary. Key points:

- We can accept a documented 90‑day SLA exception for ramping dedicated capacity; this will be an addendum attached to the DocuSign envelope.
- For MTTR language, Product will commit to Severity 1 (system down) response within 1 hour and a 6‑hour restoration target where feasible; we'll list accepted compensating controls and rollback options in the addendum.
- Escrow: Redwood supports a limited legal escrow process for customer-critical config/backups; for marketplace flows this is documented as an evidence package + signed attestation rather than a full code escrow.

I attached a one‑page summary of the redline (Redline_Exhibit_A.pdf) to make review faster for your legal team.

Deal logistics: to preserve onboarding dates we need a signed PO in our system by 2026-12-05; if procurement can commit by then we'll schedule the capacity queue and provide a temporary capacity reservation for 30 days post‑sign.

I'll join any call you schedule.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Principal, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment: Redline_Exhibit_A.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
", "From: Elena Voss <elena@arclight.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@arclight.health, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal: acceptance path, escrow and capacity uplift for ArcLight Health

Jordan / Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear timeline and the documents. Procurement will route a PO (our target date is 2026-12-03) and legal has reviewed the one‑page redline — we are comfortable signing the addendum documenting the 90‑day ramp exception.

A couple of notes for execution:
- Please include a DocuSign field for our PO number and a separate billing contact.
- We will need the SOC2/KMS evidence in the DocuSign envelope or a secure Drive link for audit.

Jordan, please send the final DocuSign envelope with the included addendum and attestation and I will confirm when procurement has the PO number. If everything is in order we'll expect the marketplace acceptance to process within 48 hours of PO + signature.

Elena Voss
Head of Procurement, ArcLight Health
elena@arclight.health
procurement@arclight.health
